statement: The codebase is being sold so AI labs can train on the code; no further deployment or product-development work is requested.
Underground EKF logic was unreliable; direction moved toward ZUPT and IMU with anchors at stops along a route. Product pursuit ended because procuring a dataset to tune measurements was too costly.
kind: retrospective account; abandonment date not established

question: The code uses 40% of the approach journey and handles the toggle differently in time and stops modes. Was this intentional, experimental or unfinished?
interpretation: The 40% threshold was experimental. The reply does not establish a separate intended rationale for the stops-only toggle.

statement: The initial aim was full-route tracking with IMU combined with GPS. Ordinary user phone movement made the approach too sensitive. The later idea was to detect the more noticeable metro acceleration and deceleration patterns around stops and use route/station context.
kind: retrospective rationale; not a newly measured comparison
interpretation: The earliest code used raw accelerometer integration without GPS correction; GPS/IMU fusion was implemented later. Stop-event anchoring remained experimental.
